_comment: Single source of truth for the on-device pipeline, shared by the app (src/config/pipelineConfig.ts, src/imageProcessing/colorFeatures.ts) and training/ (training/common.py). Changing preprocessing or features requires re-extracting features and retraining the models.

uncertainty._comment: Likely range shown with every estimate. Per region: half of the XGBoost 10-90% quantile interval, or defaultHalfWidth when there is none (backup model). Widened when photo quality, detection confidence or confounder factor are low. Fused range = weighted region half-widths plus half of any disagreement between regions, clamped to [minHalfWidth, maxHalfWidth] (photo methods are never more precise than about +/-0.6 g/dL).

quality._blurComment: Blur is judged by sharpnessScore(): Laplacian variance of the sharpest 10% of a 6x6 tile grid at 320 px. Calibrated on real Indian phone/WhatsApp photos: sharp originals 200-700; Gaussian sigma 3 about 75-130 (borderline -> auto-sharpened); sigma 5+ or strong motion blur below 60 (rejected).

fallback._comment: maxIntervalWidth: on the public training data XGBoost beat the Random Forest even on its least certain 10 % of cases, so only extreme intervals (> 8 g/dL) trigger the fallback.

skinTone._comment: Individual Typology Angle (ITA°) = atan((L* − 50) / b*) × 180/π on skin pixels (Chardon et al. 1991). Lower ITA = darker skin. Pallor on the palm is harder to see on darker skin, so the palm's fusion weight is multiplied by palmWeightFactor for the category.

confounders._comment: Weight multipliers for things that make a region look redder or paler than the blood really is. 0 = region excluded from the result. Reported conditions come from the pre-scan checklist; image flags are detected automatically.

outOfRange._comment: A region is 'outside the training range' when at least minFeaturesOutside of its key colour features fall outside the 1st-99th percentile of the training photos for the person's age group (adult/child). Such regions count less and get a wider range.

personalCalibration._comment: Offset = mean(lab Hb - photo estimate) over the person's blood tests taken within maxDaysApart of a scan, shrunk by n/(n+shrinkK) and capped.

deviceLearning._comment: Learns this phone's camera/lighting bias from every blood test entered on the device (all profiles). correction(est) = a + c*(est - center), fitted with shrinkage; only switched on when it lowers the leave-one-person-out error.
